aliases: Right to Know, Participate and Refuse

one_line_answer.text: As a worker, the law gives you three important rights: know, participate and refuse.

cites.quote: As a worker, the law also gives you three important rights:
the rights to know, participate and refuse unsafe work.

bangla_explanation: আইন প্রত্যেক কর্মীকে তিনটি right দেয়: know, participate, refuse।
Know মানে কাজের বিপদ আর করণীয় জানার অধিকার; participate মানে safety-র কাজে অংশ নেওয়া।
Refuse মানে unsafe কাজ করতে না বলা; কেউ আহত হতে পারে মনে হলে না বলুন।
এর জন্য employer আপনাকে punish বা fire করতে পারবে না।

example.en: A supervisor tells a trainee to use a grinder without a guard. The trainee says no. This is the right to refuse.
example.bn: Guard ছাড়া grinder চালাতে বললে trainee না বলতে পারে; এটাই right to refuse।

list_answer.title: Workers' safety rights

items.text: The right to know: know the dangers in your workplace and what to do.

cites.quote: You have a right to know about dangers in your workplace and
what to do about them

items.text: The right to participate: take part in keeping your workplace healthy and safe.

cites.quote: You have the right to take part in keeping your workplace healthy and safe.

items.text: The right to refuse: say no to unsafe work.

cites.quote: 3. The right to refuse unsafe work.
But you should say no if you think someone will get hurt.

items_bn: জানার অধিকার (right to know) — কাজের জায়গায় কী বিপদ আছে আর তখন কী করতে হবে, তা জানা।
অংশ নেওয়ার অধিকার (right to participate) — workplace সুস্থ ও নিরাপদ রাখার কাজে নিজেও অংশ নেওয়া।
না বলার অধিকার (right to refuse) — অনিরাপদ কাজ করতে অস্বীকার করা; এ জন্য কর্মীকে শাস্তি দেওয়া যায় না।

traps.text: The right to refuse is limited for some workers, like police and firefighters.

cites.quote: All workers have the right to refuse unsafe work, but for some workers this right is limited.
These workers can include police officers, firefighters

traps.text: Your employer cannot punish or fire you for refusing unsafe work.

cites.quote: Your employer cannot punish or fire you for refusing work that you think is unsafe.

traps.text: Get training before you start the job, not later.

cites.quote: you should also get training before you start the job.
Don't start a new job or machine with the promise of training later.

traps.text: If you are disciplined, report it to the Ministry of Labour and Employment (MOLE).

cites.quote: If you think you have been disciplined you can report it to the Ministry of Labour and Employment (MOLE)

short.prompt: As a worker, what three rights does the law give you for health and safety? Explain briefly.
short.modelAnswer:
The law gives workers three rights:
1. Right to Know: know the dangers in your workplace and what to do about them.
2. Right to Participate: take part in keeping your workplace healthy and safe.
3. Right to Refuse: refuse unsafe work if someone may get hurt.
